title: Patagonian glaciers and fjords: Torres del Paine and the canoe peoples
goal: Describe the glaciers, fjords and peoples of southern Chile and say what happens again, using volver a + infinitive.
grammar: volver a + infinitive (known), applied to Patagonia

items: I can say that something happens again with *volver a* + infinitive (*el viento vuelve a soplar*, *no volverán a crecer*).
I can describe the glaciers, fjords and national park of southern Chile.
I can use the new words for ice, glaciers and fjords.
